teaser: Three API hosts, 296 live files matching their manifests, and two places the never-edit rule did not reach: the docs and the newsroom's own copies.
core_idea: The sgit.ai API hosts publish every release as a complete, never-edited copy with a manifest of hashes; a check from outside found all 296 live files matching, and found the rule's gaps at its edges: the explaining pages, and a site that stops cutting releases of its own code.
